#### `arg1 || arg2`

Concatenates two strings, lists, or blobs. Any `NULL` input results in `NULL`. See also [`concat(arg1, arg2, ...)`](../../sql/functions/text.md#concatvalue-) and [`list_concat(list1, list2, ...)`](../../sql/functions/list.md#list_concatlist_1--list_n).

<SqlLogicTest id="sql/functions/blob/string_concat_op" />

#### `decode(blob[, on_error])`

Converts `blob` to `VARCHAR`. The optional `on_error` parameter controls handling of invalid UTF-8: `'strict'` (default, throws error), `'replace'` (replaces invalid characters with `?`), or `'ignore'` (removes invalid characters).

<SqlLogicTest id="sql/functions/blob/decode" />

#### `encode(string)`

Converts the `string` to `BLOB`. Converts UTF-8 characters into literal encoding.

<SqlLogicTest id="sql/functions/blob/encode" />

#### `from_base64(string)`

Converts a base64 encoded `string` to a character string (`BLOB`).

<SqlLogicTest id="sql/functions/blob/from_base64" />

#### `hex(blob)`

Converts `blob` to `VARCHAR` using hexadecimal encoding. Alias: `to_hex`.

<SqlLogicTest id="sql/functions/blob/hex" />

#### `md5(blob)`

Returns the MD5 hash of the `blob` as a `VARCHAR`.

<SqlLogicTest id="sql/functions/blob/md5" />

#### `md5_number(blob)`

Returns the MD5 hash of the `blob` as a `HUGEINT`.

<SqlLogicTest id="sql/functions/blob/md5_number" />

#### `octet_length(blob)`

Number of bytes in `blob`.

<SqlLogicTest id="sql/functions/blob/octet_length" />

#### `read_blob(source)`

Returns the content from `source` (a filename, a list of filenames, or a glob pattern) as a `BLOB`. See the [`read_blob` guide](../../cookbook/file_formats/read_file.md#read_blob) for more details.

<SqlLogicTest id="sql/functions/blob/read_blob" />

#### `repeat(blob, count)`

Repeats the `blob` `count` number of times.

<SqlLogicTest id="sql/functions/blob/repeat" />

#### `sha1(blob)`

Returns a `VARCHAR` with the SHA-1 hash of the `blob`.

<SqlLogicTest id="sql/functions/blob/sha1" />

#### `sha256(blob)`

Returns a `VARCHAR` with the SHA-256 hash of the `blob`.

<SqlLogicTest id="sql/functions/blob/sha256" />

#### `to_base64(blob)`

Converts a `blob` to a base64 encoded string. Alias: `base64`.

<SqlLogicTest id="sql/functions/blob/to_base64" />

#### `unbin(value)`

Converts a `value` from binary representation to a blob. Alias: `from_binary`.

<SqlLogicTest id="sql/functions/blob/unbin" />

#### `unhex(value)`

Converts a `value` from hexadecimal representation to a blob. Alias: `from_hex`.

<SqlLogicTest id="sql/functions/blob/unhex" />
